messages:
Dana (CS): Quick alert 1:12 UTC: a handful of EU onboarding sign-ins returned 401 during token exchange. I pulled impacted roster (8 trials, 2 enterprise). Sharing here to align comms and mitigation.
Marco (eng-oncall): Investigating. Provider returned invalid_client on /oauth/token. Looks like provider rotated a secret and our eu adapter didn't pick it up. Kicked off secrets-resync to secretstore-eu. ETA ~25m.
Leah (CS Ops): Recommend immediate targeted note plus offer: 14-day credit for trials, complimentary 1:1 for enterprises, and office hours links. I'll draft and send once Legal signs off.
Priya (Legal): Credits OK. Wording guidance: use "we apologize for the inconvenience"; replace any phrasing like "we caused" or "we broke" with neutral phrasing. Avoid SLA language.
deploy-bot: secrets-resync-job: started (job-id 2026-06-01-2118)
Marco (eng-oncall): Resync finished 21:36 UTC. Keys synced to secretstore-eu. Token error rate back to baseline by ~21:40 UTC. Root cause: provider secret rotation + missing region webhook. Remediation: add key-rotation webhook, region smoke test, and a health alert (owner: Marco).
Dana (CS): Drafting customer note below for Legal review.
Dana (CS): --- CUSTOMER STATUS DRAFT ---
Hi <CustomerName>,
Wewanted to let you know about a brief authentication issue some EU-based users experienced during onboarding today. Service was restored for affected users as of 21:40 UTC. If you still see 401s, please try a fresh browser sign-in and include the request timestamp and the x-rw-trace header when you reply so our team can investigate quickly.
We apologize for the inconvenience. As a gesture, weve applied a two-week credit for affected trials and scheduled a complimentary 1:1 onboarding session for impacted enterprise accounts. To book troubleshooting office hours, please use: https://cal.link/redwood-cs/office-hours.
If you have questions, reply to this thread or contact your CS rep directly.
---
Priya (Legal): Approved with small wording edits. Dana, update "we restored" to "service was restored for affected users as of 21:40 UTC" (done).
Leah (CS Ops): Sending personalized notes to the two enterprise accounts and booking 1:1s. Logging responses and renewal signals into the renewal-risk tracker.
Marco (eng-oncall): Postmortem scheduled for 09:00 UTC tomorrow; will include timeline, log snippets, and remediation plan. I'll update this thread with the postmortem link.
Dana (CS): Sent customer notes at 22:05 UTC to the impacted list and posted a short portal notice. Will flag any replies that look like churn risk for exec attention.
